eyebrow: Whole organization · unrestricted gift · AED readiness
program: Conditional value of an ordinary $100,000 gift

nutshell.headline: A real AED subsidy pathway, but ordinary-gift mortality value remains weakly identified.
nutshell.body: Central donor cost per10 QALYs: $11.08M total, $12.31M US, $15.83M Bay and $73.86M SF. Favorable joint total remains $478,425. This is a conditional prior model, not a verified offer.
nutshell.whyItMayWork: New equipment can enable earlier response; maintenance may improve existing equipment's actual readiness.
nutshell.whyWeAreCautious: Most revenue is paid services. Public/owner replacement, site arrest incidence and maintenance's incremental readiness are unmeasured.
nutshell.recommendationBlocker: No costed unfunded site queue or measured marginal readiness contrast. This packet does not support the requested $100,000/10-QALY threshold.

summary.label: Full gift
summary.detail: 30% new systems;30% maintenance;40% health unquantified, cost retained.

summary.label: Central total health
summary.detail: US0.081237 / Bay0.063184 / SF0.013539; geographic fractions are priors.

summary.label: Associated resources
summary.detail: Includes site resources and incremental medical allowance; not complete societal accounting.

programSection.body: Exact recipient EIN27-1530938 sells and supports AEDs, provides training and accepts subsidy requests. Its global installed stock is not a Bay population or count of additional lives saved.

steps.title: Allocate the whole gift
steps.detail: New five-year supported catchments and separate existing-AED maintenance years; other activities retain cost.

steps.title: Remove financing and population overlap
steps.detail: Public district and owner alternatives reduce additional activity; distinct catchments prevent repeated rescue credit.

steps.title: Value earlier effective response
steps.detail: A small maintenance readiness change is separate from a larger new-system change; one first eligible event and finite survivor health.

programSection.boundary: No unchanged transfer of the CPR-plus-AED trial benefit to maintenance; no added benefits across colocated devices, repeat arrests, public funders or partners.

model.headline: Finite first-event catchments, separate new and maintenance contrasts
model.body: All causal, marginal allocation and geographic inputs are explicit uncalibrated priors. Prices are planning anchors, not a promised marginal offer.

equation.label: Per branch
equation.expression: N = gift × allocation /cash × additionality × distinct fraction. Q = N × coverage change × survival gain × utility × exp(−discount×delay) × integral[0,min(active,H)] hazard×exp(−(hazard+discount)t)×annuity(mortality+discount,H−t)dt. Subtract gift-date direct and alternative health losses.

model.uncertaintyBoundary: Scenarios are not weighted confidence intervals. Negative health and zero local denominators are retained. Zero associated resources is not a general lower bound when signed savings are allowed.
model.fundingBoundary: Official subsidies and paid public partnership exist, but no verified remaining marginal package. FY2025 surplus/cash do not prove an unrestricted deployable tranche.

evidence.result: 30 survivors/128 arrests versus15/107; randomized-unit survivor-count comparison.
evidence.transfer: Supports new response-system plausibility. Does not measure maintenance versus already installed AEDs or establish the model's conditional per-arrest effect.

evidence.design: Official service and intake pages; FY2025 tax filing
evidence.population: Worldwide AED sites; some Bay partnerships
evidence.result: Current maintenance/subsidy pathways and fee-dominated revenue verified.
evidence.transfer: No observed whole-gift allocation, marginal readiness, unique-site incidence or residence shares.

reservations: Paid public/owner services could replace donations completely.
Five-year new-system cash is a planning bundle and the early-response contrast is unmeasured.
The total effect is small and both central and favorable joint cases fail the threshold.
Partial resources include no quantified opportunity cost of the retained unmodeled portfolio beyond the full gift; displaced health remains independently parameterized.
excludedBenefits: Repeated arrests and multiple AEDs rescuing the same person
Education, awareness and nonfatal morbidity without explicit causal bridges
Partner/public-funded benefits already present without the gift
